rationale: The bounded change affects product semantics and spans three canonical owners, while derived-path propagation is not deterministic. This excludes trivial_change, quick_task, and verified_change. compact_delivery is also ineligible because the evidence does not show a completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task context. With no broader runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact, structured_slice is the smallest supported non-authorizing candidate.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement only.
canonical_owner_count=3, so the one-owner verified_change condition fails.
derived_path_count=4 and deterministic_propagation=false, so deterministic derived-path proof is unavailable.
impacts.product_semantics=true, requiring a governed delivery path.
No completed Brownfield analysis is supplied.
No stored quick_task context is supplied.
All supplied broader-impact flags are false, supporting structured_slice rather than structured_delivery.
Any impact beyond the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
